issues.description: When a caller began volunteering an SSN, the agent <ref job="SRJ_sQFuNxGcZpio" item="item_f2f58a96-4a1">stopped the disclosure without repeating it</ref>, but omitted the required explanation that SSN collection belongs to a later formal application with explicit authorization. The <ref job="SRJ_kLw8xTxS5bqS" item="item_579b18c1-cdd">same abbreviated response</ref> was used when a caller also volunteered a street address.
issues.suggestion: Route volunteered SSNs and property addresses through the mandated item-specific disclosures, covering non-collection now and secure collection at the appropriate later stage without echoing the data.
issues.label: Sensitive data
